page: Any page with the sidebar expanded
element: The chats section's search: its button, or the field once search is open
lookup: A button named "Search chats" inside the chats section, else the `search` element there

page: Any page with the sidebar expanded
lookup: A button named "Filter chats" inside the chats section

page: Any page with the sidebar open
element: The user menu at the bottom of the sidebar

page: Any page with the sidebar open
element: The Usage link at the bottom of the sidebar
lookup: A link named "Usage" inside the navigation landmark

page: New chat, conversation and project view
element: The message composer as a whole: the text field with its +, model and Send controls
lookup: The smallest element holding both the first on-screen `textarea` inside `#main-content` and the button named "Send message"; the `textarea` alone when there is no such button

page: New chat, conversation and project view
element: The composer's + button that adds attachments
lookup: A button named "Add" in the region, section or form around the on-screen composer field; nothing on a page without a composer

page: New chat, conversation and project view
lookup: A button named "Send message" around the on-screen composer field; replaced by Stop while a reply streams

page: New chat, conversation and project view
lookup: A button inside `#main-content` named "Select model", or "Select model: " followed by the chosen model

page: New chat, conversation and project view
element: The composer's dictation button, when voice input is available
lookup: A button named "Dictate" around the on-screen composer field

element: The starter prompts, when the selected model has any
lookup: The `role="list"` named "Conversation starters" inside `#main-content`
The `role="log"` named "Conversation messages" inside `#main-content`

element: The button that opens the sources panel
lookup: A button named "Open panel" inside `#main-content`; absent while the panel is open
The first on-screen button named "New project" inside `#main-content`
The `search` element around the input named "Search projects" inside `#main-content`

element: The project's chats section, with its composer
lookup: The `section` named "Project chats" inside `#main-content`, once the project has loaded
The `aside` labelled "Details" inside `#main-content`, once the project has loaded
A button named "New task" inside `#main-content`
The `search` element around the input named "Search scheduled tasks by name" inside `#main-content`
A button named "Create" inside the catalog `section`
The first `search` element or `role="search"` inside the catalog `section`
The first `role="tablist"` inside the catalog `section`
The `role="radiogroup"` named like the view switch inside the catalog `section`
The `role="tablist"` labelled "Settings" inside `#main-content`

element: The action bar (Copy, Regenerate…) under the newest message, normally the latest answer; it appears once the answer has finished
lookup: The last on-screen `role="toolbar"` named "Message actions" inside the `role="log"` named "Conversation messages"

element: The catalog's source filter button ("From", or "My" while only your own items are shown)
lookup: A button inside the catalog `section` named "From", "From: …", "My" or "My · …"

element: The sort menu on desktop; the browse-settings button that holds sorting on a phone
lookup: A button inside the catalog `section` named after one of the sort orders ("Recently Updated", "Newest", "Name A-Z"), else a button named "Browse settings"

element: The first catalog card on screen — a favorite's card when the favorites row is shown; open it to see the item's details
lookup: The first on-screen `article` with an accessible name inside the catalog `section`

element: The favorite star of the first card on screen
lookup: The first on-screen button inside the catalog `section` named "Add to favorites" or "Remove from favorites"

element: The item details drawer as a whole
lookup: The on-screen the `role="dialog"` named "Item details"
A button named "Use in chat" inside the `role="dialog"` named "Item details"

element: The drawer's "Manage" menu button (only for items you can manage)
lookup: A button named "Manage" inside the `role="dialog"` named "Item details"

element: The toolset's sign-in or credentials button
lookup: A button named "Log in", "Log out" or "Manage credentials" inside the `role="dialog"` named "Item details"
A button named "Share" inside the `role="dialog"` named "Item details"
A button named "Publish" or "Unpublish" inside the `role="dialog"` named "Item details"
The first `role="tablist"` inside the `role="dialog"` named "Item details"
The nearest button named "Create" or "Save" around the `section` named "Context" inside `#main-content`

element: The form's "Context" section for knowledge files
lookup: The `section` named "Context" inside `#main-content`
The nearest button named "Edit" around the `aside` named "Details" inside `#main-content`
The nearest button named "More actions" around the `aside` named "Details" inside `#main-content`
The nearest button named "Pin" or "Unpin" around the `aside` named "Details" inside `#main-content`
The nearest button named "Publish" or "Unpublish" around the `aside` named "Details" inside `#main-content`

element: The search over the project's context files
lookup: The search field named "Search context files" inside the `aside` named "Details"
The `role="group"` named "Sort" inside `#main-content`
The nearest button named "Create" or "Save" around the `role="group"` named "Configuration" inside `#main-content`

element: The form's "Configuration" section: the task's instructions
lookup: The `role="group"` named "Configuration" inside `#main-content`
The `role="combobox"` named "Repeat" inside `#main-content`
A button or `role="combobox"` inside `#main-content` whose name starts with "Model or Agent"
A button named "Start now" or "Starting…" inside `#main-content`
The nearest button named "Edit" around the list named "History" inside `#main-content`
The list named "History" inside `#main-content`

element: The task's "Active" switch, which pauses and resumes it
lookup: The `role="switch"` named "Active" inside `#main-content`
The nearest button named after a sort order ("First to run", "Last to run", "Newest", "Name A-Z") around the search field named like the page's search
The `role="table"` named "Extensions" inside `#main-content`
A button named "Log in" or its logging-in state inside the table named "Extensions"
The `role="combobox"` named "Theme" inside `#main-content`
The `role="combobox"` named "Language" inside `#main-content`

element: The button that duplicates the chat so it can be edited, in place of the composer
lookup: A button named "Duplicate the conversation to be able to edit it" inside `#main-content`

element: The conversation's files and sources panel
lookup: The on-screen `aside` named "Conversation sources"
A button named "Download all" inside the `aside` named "Conversation sources"
A button inside `#main-content` whose name starts with "Back to"

element: The composer's tools chip ("Tools: 2 of 5 on")
lookup: A button in the composer whose name starts with "Tools:"
The `section` named "Setup" inside `#main-content`

page: Any page with the sidebar open and a conversation open
element: The open conversation's row in the chat list
lookup: The on-screen element with `aria-current="page"` inside the chats `section` of the navigation landmark

page: Any page with the sidebar open and a conversation open
element: The open conversation's "More actions" menu (pin, duplicate, export, share…); its button shows on hover
lookup: The button named "More actions" in the same list item as the open conversation's row
